p, k = map(int, input().split())

def power(a, p, mod=1000000007):
    res = 1
    while p > 0:
        if p % 2 == 1:
            res = (res * a) % mod
        a = (a * a) % mod
        p //= 2
    return res

if k == 0:
    print(power(p, p - 1))
elif k == 1:
    print(power(p, p))
else:
    order = 1
    a = k
    while a != 1:
        a = (a * k) % p
        order += 1
    print(power(p, (p - 1) // order))
